newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - 3 specialty healthcare cos start.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - 3 specialty healthcare cos start.

text.p: -- CS First Boston said it initiated three specialty heath care stocks.
-- started CRA Managed Care Inc and OccuSystems Inc with strong buy ratings, and started Complete Management Inc as buy.
-- said CRA, a provider of workers' compensation case management and other cost containment services, is in an attractive niche market.
-- said CRA has strong same-store growth opportunities and an efficient cost structure.
-- estimates 1997 earnings $1.50 a share, compared to $1.19 in 1996.
-- said OccuSystems, the nation's largest primary care occupational health physician practice management company, delivers care efficiently.
-- set six to 12 month price target of $30 to $32 a share.
-- estimates 1997 earnings $0.81 a share, compared to $0.59 in 1996.
-- said Complete Management is an early entrant in the highly fragemented and highly regulated New York State market.
-- said New York's regulatory landscape has been changing.
-- estimates 1997 earnings of $0.88 share, compared to $0.66 in 1996.
-- Complete Management stock closed at 12-3/4 Wednesday.
